from.meaning: The exact default key combination of one editable Sway binding. Keysyms resolve through XKB; aliases cannot duplicate a modifier.

to.meaning: The new modifier-plus-XKB-keysym combination, or explicit null to reset the override. A modifier may not be repeated through an alias; occupied combinations are refused.

changed.meaning: Whether the override changed on success; false for an unchanged request or a wrapped failure.

mutationPerformed.meaning: False for no-ops and early refusals, equal to changed on success; on a failed rollback it can be true when the file had changed.

receiptPath.meaning: Optional legacy receipt-file path from older staff; absent when staff writes no receipt file.

receipt.meaning: Settings metadata with ok, changed, kind, requested fields, backups and commands, including Sway reload when attempted.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Present on refusal. Computed messages include unknown-field:<key>, shortcuts-key-taken:<label-or-default-keys>, rollback-failed:<rollback-error>:<first-error> and missing envelope kernel keys: <comma-separated keys>. Raw exception diagnostics are not a closed set.
